headline: Strategic plan approved, with new language on matching staffing to service levels and on library collections.
summary: Earlier, the director reported on a building-wide code of conduct policy that goes to City Council Monday. Staff also reported open positions and new training on what to do if ICE visits a library. Budget talks with the city were also covered.
decisions: Approved the strategic plan with changes on staffing levels and library collections.
discussion: Strategic plan wording: Members went through the vision, pillars, and bullet points, changing words such as evolving to growing and residents to people. They also discussed whether collections and programs should be listed together.
City budget requests: Staff said the city must trim its budget, and that personnel makes up most of the library's budget. Five new asks were presented, and staff doubted all would be granted.

ICE response training: Staff were retrained on a July law that bars civil arrests in public libraries. Staff were told to document an arrest, not interfere, and members asked whether filming and university libraries are covered.
Building code of conduct: Staff said the citywide policy is general and does not conflict with the library's own policy. Training and enforcement steps are still to be set.

decision_evidence.quote: So, a motion is to approve the strategic plan as amended in the document in the shared drive as amended. ... Seeing none, the strategic plan has passed by the library board.
